_README: HUMAN-OWNED decisions. A decision counts only when value is true AND decided_by AND decided_on are filled in by the person who made it. Engineering must not set these. Each gate reads this file; a bare 'true' is ignored.

population_confirmed_by_owner.note: Owner confirms docs/HAIRLINE_VALIDATION_POPULATION.md, including decision D1 (who the hair module is validated for).

acceptance_thresholds_agreed.note: Real-photo acceptance thresholds in docs/HAIRLINE_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA.md section B agreed and signed BEFORE the first run. None are defined today.

second_annotator_available.note: A second, independent human annotator has been identified and briefed with docs/HAIRLINE_ANNOTATION_SOP.md.

adjudication_procedure_defined.note: Who adjudicates A/B disagreements, and the consensus rule (including how a consensus polyline is formed). NOT DEFINED today.
